name: Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling: Toukon Road - Brave Spirits
summary: Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling: Toukon Road - Brave Spirits is a professional wrestling game released in 1997 for the PlayStation. It features wrestlers from New Japan Pro-Wrestling and focuses on simulation-style matches with a range of moves and techniques. The game includes multiple modes, including tournament and exhibition matches.
